claims.quote: Type locality is 'Bo River (= Sungai Boh), Mahakam River basin, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia', a tributary of the Mahakam river system in East Kalimantan province, Indonesia (Borneo) and this species is distributed throughout much of the island including parts of Sarawak state, Malaysia.

Type locality is 'Bo River (= Sungai Boh), Mahakam River basin, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia', a tributary of the Mahakam river system in East Kalimantan province, Indonesia (Borneo) and this species is distributed throughout much of the island including parts of Sarawak state, Malaysia.
It's also been recorded in Peninsular Malaysia with the Maenam Tapi river in Surat Thani province, southern (peninsular) Thailand representing the northern limit of its known range.
